prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a square 1:1 cinematic holiday red-carpet after-party portrait of two adult women standing arm-in-arm in a luxury indoor venue. The left adult woman has long loose blonde waves and wears a pure-white strapless satin mini dress with delicate three-dimensional floral appliques, white lace peep-toe heels, glamorous makeup and bold red lipstick. The right adult woman has soft elegant blonde waves and wears a shimmering holiday-red strapless ruched evening gown with metallic heels. Surround them with red poinsettias, Christmas greenery, ornaments, subtle warm fairy lights, dark wooden panels and softly blurred guests. Use warm golden cinematic spot lighting, soft falloff, natural skin texture and high-fashion editorial realism. Use only approved event branding and do not reproduce public-figure likenesses.
